value: Trebor recounts failure in battle, then a return to the Blasted Lands to rescue the men left behind. The account is one of defeat and obligation: he could not leave the captured soldiers to their torment. The reproduced Horde dialogue speaks of nineteen of his men, while the binding-stone objective counts eighteen bound servants. These are kept as two source details in tension. The surviving evidence does not resolve the difference.
editorNote: The nineteen-men versus eighteen-stones discrepancy is preserved explicitly; do not merge the populations or infer an unstated fate.
